name: Swift Woo Search – eCommerce Live Search
author: pantherius

sections.description:
Swift Woo Search replaces the default WooCommerce search with a blazing fast AJAX-powered search experience. Display instant results with product images, prices, and custom layout both on mobile and desktop – all without reloading the page.

Easily customizable, responsive, and compatible with any modern WooCommerce theme. A must-have UX upgrade for any WooCommerce store.

Features

  • Instant AJAX search results (products only)
  • Mobile and desktop optimized UI
  • Displays product images, prices, and titles
  • Search results page enhancement with weighted logic
  • Custom scoring based on keyword position and relevance
  • Tag- and category-based fallback logic
  • Smooth animations and fast performance
  • Responsive, lightweight codebase
  • Custom “Search more” link for full results page
  • Works with any WooCommerce theme
  • No jQuery dependency – fully vanilla JavaScript
  • SEO-friendly and accessible (aria-label, keyboard nav)
  • Easy setup, plug-and-play functionality
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/swift-woo-search directory or install via the WordPress admin panel.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. A new search icon will appear in your main navigation (you can change its location if needed).
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with my theme?

Yes, it is designed to be compatible with all major WooCommerce themes.

Can I customize the search design?

Yes, the plugin includes flexible styling via its CSS file, which you can override or modify.

Does it affect the native WooCommerce search?

Yes – it enhances it by replacing the default logic with a smarter, weighted algorithm that returns better product matches.

Does it slow down my site?

No. The plugin is built to be extremely fast, using pure JavaScript and optimized AJAX calls.
